svg.title: How Argus decides
svg.desc: The decision pipeline: what Argus watches, which edges it follows, which groups it checks and when evidence is enough, with the early exits for late data, plans and mix shifts.

text.font-family: Outfit, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Outfit, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every step is code with a fixed rule. Every number comes from a SQL query with a receipt.
